Save a montage at its exact physical size

Source: R/render.R
save_montage.Rd

Renders the montage and saves it at its fixed physical size, set with adjust_size() (by default, the panel grid fits into 90 x 90 mm). The file format is taken from the file extension: .pdf, .png, .tif/.tiff, .jpg/.jpeg or .svg. Bitmaps are written with the ragg package if it is installed, for consistent output on all systems. PDF and SVG files are written with Cairo graphics where it is available. Without it (e.g. on macOS without XQuartz), PDF falls back to R's standard PDF device and SVG to the svglite package.

Usage

save_montage(montage, filename, dpi = 300, ...)

Arguments

montage

A tidymontage() object.

filename

File to write.

dpi

Resolution of the image panels, and of bitmap files. Panels are binned down to this resolution at the printed size.

...

Passed to the graphics device.

Value

The montage, invisibly.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
montage |> save_montage("figure.pdf")
montage |> adjust_size(width = 180, height = NA) |> save_montage("figure.pdf")
} # }
